acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-update check --component tasks` reports installedVersion as the plain version string (e.g. `0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.407`), not the full `corvint-tasks version` JSON envelope.
A test covers the Tasks version parse, including the JSON envelope form.
body:
Observed 2026-10-10 on darwin-arm64. `corvint-update` built from origin/main 284c4312, `corvint-tasks` build 407.

Repro: `corvint-update check --component tasks --allow-network`.

Expected: installedVersion is the short Tasks version, matching how Core reports `Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 407)`.

Actual: installedVersion holds the entire `corvint-tasks version` JSON result (formats list, warnings, etc.) escaped into a string, a multi-kilobyte field. installedBuild (407) is correct. Related but distinct: V1-0639 (check does not say whether the available release is newer).
title: corvint-update check reports the Tasks installedVersion as the whole version JSON envelope
